_comment: Pinned simulators for the nightly simbench runs (docs/simbench_nightly_plan.md §2). Kept apart from tools.lock.json so moving a simulator pin does not change the lock hash of the solver perf records, and the reverse. Each bundle unpacks into its own directory (`into`): both Verilator bundles unpack to verilator/. Changing anything here changes the lock hash every simbench record carries.

verilator-bin-5.054._comment: First release with sampler control (+verilator+rand+sampler+, verilator#8899).

xezim-bin-0.11.3._comment: Release track (upstream tag 0.11.3). manylinux_2_34: needs glibc 2.34; the runner image (Ubuntu 22.04) has 2.35.
